name: Sales / Distribution Analyst
description: Performs analytical support across the Sales, Distribution & Marketing value stream, spanning distribution operating-model design, self-service channel operations, and digital channel performance optimization. Maintains and certifies producer compliance records, verifies producer license status, and supports producer termination governance and agency-broker relationship oversight through CRM and GRC platforms.

name: Sales Development Representative
description: Coordinates lead management across the Sales, Distribution & Marketing funnel, covering lead capture, scoring, routing, and nurturing. Designs segmented nurture journeys, defines qualification criteria by line of business, and distributes eligible leads to agency and broker partners. Administers the CRM, instruments funnel analytics, and records marketing consent and TCPA status.

name: Sales Operations Analyst
description: Performs the operational backbone of the Sales, Distribution & Marketing value stream, supporting distribution operating-model design, quote-to-bind producer support, and self-service channel operations. Builds propensity models and channel performance dashboards, logs bound submissions in the CRM, and supports producer compliance monitoring, delegated authority oversight, and producer termination governance.

name: Salvage Coordinator
description: Coordinates recovery activity within the Claims value stream, posting recovery receipts to the claims ledger and closing demand files. Supports claims workflow routing by monitoring exceptions and rebalancing misrouted claims, documents liability decisions and denials, and tracks retained-asset-account compliance with scheduled regulatory reporting through the claims management platform.

name: Sanctions Analyst
description: Performs sanctions screening and alert adjudication within the Risk, Compliance & Audit value stream, investigating escalated potential matches, documenting disposition rationale, and freezing assets on confirmed hits. Maintains the sanctions watchlist and screening policy, tunes screening-engine thresholds, screens third parties for corruption and PEP risk, and supports financial crime committee governance.

name: Scrum Master
description: Leads agile delivery within Product & Delivery, facilitating sprint planning, story-point estimation, and the team's Definition of Done under the agile delivery framework. Coordinates business acceptance testing and readiness planning, maps cross-team release dependencies, drafts and distributes release communications, and drives continuous improvement through codified delivery metrics.

name: Security Analyst
description: Administers identity and access controls within the Cybersecurity & IAM value stream, running access certification and entitlement review campaigns with reminders, escalations, and completion tracking. Manages directory services health, replication monitoring, and backup testing, supports multi-factor authentication administration and privileged activity auditing, and onboards applications to the SSO platform.

name: Security Engineer
description: Owns hands-on security engineering across the Cybersecurity & IAM value stream, covering web application firewall management, container security, and cloud security posture management. Embeds controls in the secure software development lifecycle by scanning container images and IaC templates in the pipeline, and hardens privileged access by discovering unmanaged accounts and revoking excessive standing privileges.

name: Security GRC Analyst
description: Oversees cybersecurity governance within the Cybersecurity & IAM value stream, managing policy lifecycles, control framework ownership, and audit deficiency remediation to closure. Scopes cyber risk assessments, rates inherent risk and derives residual risk from control effectiveness, runs the security awareness training program, and reports security metrics and third-party cyber risk through the GRC platform.

name: Senior Accountant
description: Performs financial control work anchored in the Finance & Investments value stream, preparing financial statements, statutory reserve schedules, and actuarial liability balances. Supports capital instruments and share repurchase program management, financial examinations, and M&A financial support, and reconciles claims and ALAE data across actuarial and claims processes for completeness and consistency.

name: Senior Contact Center Agent
description: Owns complaint handling within the Call Center value stream, from formal complaint intake and investigation through resolution determination and corrective action confirmation. Establishes resolution target dates, assigns corrective-action owners, flags bad-faith or litigation-risk complaints, and supports complaint analytics and regulatory reporting by calculating and benchmarking complaint ratios per 1,000 policies.

name: Senior Developer
description: Leads engineering delivery within the Technology & Engineering value stream, owning infrastructure-as-code, environment lifecycle management, and data pipeline CI/CD. Defines secret rotation policies with automated rotation, maintains the Helm chart library and CMDB governance, retires deprecated IaC modules, and reports cloud security posture drift to governance through weekly dashboards.

name: Senior Underwriter
description: Owns complex risk selection within the Underwriting value stream, handling policy binding, mid-term endorsements, and quote negotiation and re-issuance to brokers. Administers the reinsurance program by screening treaties for retention and preparing bordereaux, applies experience and schedule rating adjustments, and supports appetite guideline management, exception tracking, and underwriting quality assurance.
